business_summary: Qingdao Eastsoft Communication Technology Co.,Ltd engages in the research, design, development, and sales of power line carrier communication products and integrated circuit chips in China and internationally. The company's products include general-purpose and dedicated microcontroller chips, power line carrier chips, wireless RF chips, and battery management chips, providing comprehensive, multi-level integrated circuit chip solutions for smart manufacturing and IoT industry clients. It is also involved in the new energy, digital intelligence transformation, and smart manufacturing business. Qingdao Eastsoft Communication Technology Co.,Ltd was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Qingdao, China.
